$A$ due south and $B$ due east give $\angle ACB=90^{\circ}$.
$AC=\dfrac{150}{\tan30^{\circ}}=259.80\ldots\text{ m}$
$CB=\dfrac{150}{\tan40^{\circ}}=178.76\ldots\text{ m}$
$AB=\sqrt{AC^2+CB^2}$
$\approx315\text{ m}$
